behaviors.behavior: AC-1 a rewrite carries the destination's existing mode
AC-2 a first write stays at mkstemp's 0600 - carry, never invent
the mode selected is the destination's, masked to 0o7777
AC-3 a refused fchmod never fails the write, and is counted
AC-3 a refused stat never fails the write, end-to-end
a raising carrier still unlinks the temp (defence in depth, NOT AC-3)
a refused fchmod is counted, not silently swallowed
a refused stat is counted (mode unknowable, not absent)
an absent destination is 'nothing to carry', not a failure
the carry is applied BEFORE the fsync that lands the bytes
no-op where os.fchmod does not exist
os.name=='nt' alone disables the carry even if fchmod appears
AC-4 winerror 33 is in the sharing-violation set
AC-4 a winerror-33 failure is retried end-to-end and each retry counted
a winerror outside the set still re-raises immediately
the atomic_write alias IS the leaf's frozenset, not a fork
AC-5 a contended FileLock raises LockTimeout inside its budget
AC-5 the LockTimeout message names the lock AND the wait
behaviors.evidence: same test - asserts str(lock_path) in message and 'waited' in message

behaviors.behavior: AC-7 timeout_seconds=0 is EXACTLY one non-blocking attempt
AC-7 timeout_seconds=None restores the unbounded block
AC-7 NaN/inf/negative/non-numeric timeouts are rejected
AC-6 same-thread nesting enters immediately and holds to the outermost exit
an exception inside a nested block still releases the lock
AC-8 a timed-out instance leaks no handle and still works afterwards

behaviors.behavior: a real fault propagates instead of being polled for the budget

behaviors.behavior: the registry key is independent of the working directory
lock_key never raises, so FileLock.__init__ stays infallible
reentrancy is per-thread - a second thread never inherits ownership
a release by a non-owner does not free the owner's lock
a forked child does not ACQUIRE the parent's lock reentrantly
a forked child does not RELEASE the parent's lock
the loader fallback still loads a lib module past a shadowing lib
a sibling import inside a loaded lib module resolves
the loader never puts shared/scripts/lib on sys.path
an unknown module still raises ImportError
the E2E runner fixtures carry BOTH new sibling modules
real POSIX chmod/fchmod semantics on a live filesystem
